question: What does Form 12 (the standard access and benefit-sharing contract in Appendix IV of Decree 43/2026) contain, and do strains already held in public collections need a new access licence before they are supplied for commercial use?
why_it_matters: Decides how cheap and fast a characterised strain set (SLF-C1) or any T9 venture using a Vietnamese strain can be; the decree PDF we read did not include the forms
cheapest_way_to_close: Read Appendix IV on vanban.chinhphu.vn or the official gazette; one written question to the MAE Department of Nature Conservation and Biodiversity
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Nature Conservation and Biodiversity

question: What does VTCC charge to supply a food strain for commercial use, on what licence terms, and which of its 3,869 documented strains are food moulds and yeasts (Aspergillus oryzae, Rhizopus, Amylomyces, Kluyveromyces marxianus, Pichia kudriavzevii)?
why_it_matters: Sets the cost and partner for SLF-C1 and the strain route for T9
cheapest_way_to_close: One call or email to VTCC; the same questions to FIRI's Industrial Microbiology Center
owner_org_to_ask: VTCC (VNU Hanoi Institute of Microbiology and Biotechnology); FIRI

question: What fermenter volume, utilisation and food-safety certification does YERA's Nghe An yeast-protein plant have, and would it rent spare capacity?
why_it_matters: It is the only domestic food-grade biomass fermenter we found outside the amino-acid makers; a possible first T5 host or user
cheapest_way_to_close: One call to Yeast Era JSC; its environmental permit on the provincial portal

question: What would a 50 to 5,000 L food-grade pilot fermentation line with downstream drying cost to build and equip in Vietnam?
why_it_matters: T5's capital is not estimated; the only anchor is a European construction contract of close to EUR 2 million with unclear scope
cheapest_way_to_close: Three budget quotes (GEA, Rieckermann, one Chinese supplier) plus a building cost from a hi-tech park

question: Is the Phenikaa Pichia kudriavzevii isolate YPI-Y2 (62 to 67% protein) safe as a food yeast (safety status, virulence traits, RNA content), and has it been deposited in a collection?
why_it_matters: The only Vietnamese protein-strain screen found; its safety decides whether it can enter SLF-C1 or a product
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the authors; check the EFSA qualified-presumption-of-safety list

question: Do Vietnamese soy-sauce brewers run industrial koji rooms (solid-state Aspergillus oryzae) that could host T9 trials or supply characterised starter?
why_it_matters: Industrial koji capacity would give T9 an incumbent partner; two searches found nothing
cheapest_way_to_close: Masan Consumer annual report; calls to two soy-sauce makers
